description: ODC: DELETE, without force, elements whose consumers the platform maintains on its own (tested coverage, phase 2): the IArgument with which the SQL node passes the parameter it declares itself, the OnBeforeRequestCallback property of the REST client and the OnRequestCallback of the exposed REST (the plugin clears them when the callback goes away), the IDecisionOutcomeNode of each connector of a Decision (the platform regenerates the decision's internal flow) and the module's DefaultScreen (InsuranceApp has no default screen, the first screen created headless takes that role; Studio deletes the screen and leaves only the warning 'Unknown Default Screen', which the job resolves by choosing the new default screen). Before, all of them refused the delete. Same scenario in the O11 lane: tests/jobs/delete-platform-consumers.json and tests/jobs/delete-default-screen.json.

expectedMessages.why: ODC: an app (CrossDevice) does not expose a public server action (the live Studio gives an error); the action stays private and without a consumer in this proof job
